q1.question: How is AImperia different from platforms like Zoom, Microsoft Teams, or Google Meets?
q1.answer: AImperia is a specialized platform for online lessons that includes all the necessary tools for learning: video call, interactive board, auto notes, and much more. Unlike Zoom, Microsoft Teams, or Google Meets, AImperia provides a ready-made solution for educational institutions and teachers. In addition, AImperia automatically creates notes from what is said in the lesson and highlighted on the board, allowing you to focus on learning, not on writing notes and trying to summarize information.

q2.question: How high is the quality of lessons and how much does AI help in learning?
q2.answer: AImperia provides the opportunity to study with experienced teachers who have extensive experience in education. AI helps create auto notes that automatically record everything said in the lesson and highlight important points on the interactive board. After the lesson, you can review, repeat, or download the notes as a PDF. Also, AI allows you to ask questions during the lesson and get answers, making learning more interactive and effective.

q3.question: How do I sign up for a lesson and choose a teacher?
q3.answer: To sign up for a lesson, you need to register on the AImperia platform and let us know which subject and level you are interested in. We will help you choose a suitable teacher and arrange a lesson time.

q4.question: How does a lesson go and what tools are used?
q4.answer: The lesson takes place as a video call using an interactive board where the teacher can draw, write, and highlight important points. Auto notes are also used, which automatically record everything said in the lesson and highlight important points on the board. After the lesson, you can review, repeat, or download the notes as a PDF.

q5.question: Can I use this platform if I have my own teacher?
q5.answer: Yes, you can use the AImperia platform for lessons with your own teacher. Both you and your teacher need to register on the platform and agree on a lesson time. You will be able to use all the platform's tools, including video call, interactive board, and auto notes.

q6.question: Does AImperia provide support if I study with my own teacher?
q6.answer: Yes, AImperia provides support to all users, regardless of whether they study with their own teacher or with platform teachers. You can contact support for any questions related to using the platform, and we will try to help you as soon as possible.

q7.question: What subjects can I study on the AImperia platform?
q7.answer: On the AImperia platform, you can study various subjects, including mathematics, physics, chemistry, informatics, and others. If you are interested in a specific subject, let us know and we will try to find a suitable teacher for you.

q8.question: How can I contact AImperia support?
q8.answer: You can contact AImperia support through the feedback form on the website, by email, or in the platform chat. We will try to answer your question as soon as possible.
